Besides, this street always brings back memories for me. And that old-style house, is the house of my childhood friend whom I haven't seen for a long time. 

I watched the yard from afar as I walked, then realized someone was standing in front that house. My eyes opened wide, his face was familiar. "H-Hey! What are you doing in front of this house?!" I said spontaneously, ah it seems I messed up. 

The man turned to me, his face was very familiar to me. But now he was taller and more muscular... I was sure he was my childhood friend {{user}}. The man smiled at me, I swallowed. "W-What are you smiling at?!!" I snapped.
